set.description: Pick the channel of a game and start a new round

reset.description: Start a game over, keeping its channel

skip.description: Reveal the answer of the current puzzle and start a new one

notConfigured: No {game} channel yet. Use `/game set` first
channelTaken: This channel already hosts {game}. Pick another one

counting.start: Start counting! The first number is **1**
counting.wrongNumber: Wrong, the next number was **{expected}**. Start again from **1**! Record: **{best}**
counting.sameUser: No counting twice in a row. Start again from **1**! Record: **{best}**

scramble.title: 🔤 Vietnamese scramble
scramble.prompt: Rearrange the letters into a Vietnamese word

wordle.start: 🟩 New Wordle! Guess an English word of {length} letters; the channel has {max} guesses
wordle.notInList: Not in the word list; no guess used
wordle.sameUser: You guessed last; let someone else go
wordle.lost: Out of guesses! The answer was **{answer}**

WORD_CHAIN.rules: Each player sends an English word starting with the last letter of the previous one. No repeated words, nobody twice in a row. Each accepted word scores 1 point.
WORD_CHAIN.setup: `/word set channel:#channel` picks the channel (optional `max-words`); `/word reset` starts over.

COUNTING.rules: The channel counts 1, 2, 3… one number per message, nobody twice in a row. A wrong number or a second number in a row starts over from 1; the record stays. Each right number scores 1 point. Messages that are not numbers are ignored.
COUNTING.setup: `/game set game:Counting channel:#channel`; `/game reset game:Counting` starts over from 1.

SCRAMBLE.rules: The bot shows the shuffled letters of a Vietnamese word of 2–3 syllables. The first to send a real word using exactly those letters scores 1 point and gets a new puzzle. Wrong guesses cost nothing and get no answer.
SCRAMBLE.setup: `/game set game:Vietnamese scramble channel:#channel`; `/game skip game:Vietnamese scramble` reveals the answer and gives a new one.

WORDLE.rules: The channel solves one 5-letter English word together in 6 guesses; nobody guesses twice in a row. 🟩 right spot, 🟨 in the word elsewhere, ⬛ not in the word. Solving it scores 1 point. Out of guesses reveals the answer and starts a new board.
WORDLE.setup: `/game set game:Wordle channel:#channel`; `/game skip game:Wordle` reveals the answer and starts a new board.
